description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud (Dark)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Hazardous Darkness (0~2), removed after using Apex Hazardous Darkness two times

description.name: Apex Hazardous Darkness Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Hazardous Darkness level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud (Dark)]

description.name: Apex Hazardous Darkness Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Hazardous Darkness level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud (Dark)]
